title: iberis dunalii
intro: Iberis dunalii, commonly known as Candytuft, is a flowering plant species in the mustard family. It is known for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues, such as coughs and colds, due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Iberis dunalii include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of various conditions. The bioactive constituents of Iberis dunalii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
